candidate.background_need: A fictional enterprise network lacks a shared problem assessment to determine whether the barrier is missing customers, staff skills, or duplicated administrative work.

objectives.description: Conduct a joint diagnostic workshop with members to identify the primary business constraint.

preliminary_activities.description: Organize a joint diagnostic workshop with members to identify the primary business constraint.

expected_results.description: Members agree on a single primary problem requiring intervention.

proposed_indicators.description: Percentage of workshop participants who can explicitly name the agreed-upon primary business constraint.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Post-workshop survey with multiple-choice question on identified problem.

messages.content: Return a valid JSON object only.

You are a careful EU project-planning assistant. Prompt version: concept_v1.
Return only valid JSON that matches the expected schema. Do not include markdown fences or explanatory text.

Stage: concept

User input:
Fictional project idea:
{"schema_version":1,"title":"Fictional Better Business Platform","development_need":"A fictional enterprise network says it needs a platform. Members disagree whether the problem is missing customers, staff skills or duplicated administrative work. No common problem assessment has been completed.","target_groups":["Fictional network members; exact roles and needs not yet agreed"],"expected_change":"Members want business to improve, but the intended measurable change has not been agreed.","geography":"Fictional region; exact area not specified","partners":null,"funding_context":"One fictional proposer assumes every digital project receives EU funding; no evidence is supplied."}

Create a concise ConceptPaper with exactly one objective (O1), one preliminary activity (A1) linked to O1, one expected result (R1) linked to A1, and one measurable proposed indicator (I1) linked to R1. Use one target group. Keep descriptions to one short sentence each. Use empty assumptions and open_questions.

Write all human-readable text fields in English. Keep JSON field names, schema_version and O/A/R/I identifiers unchanged. Do not translate keys or IDs.
